name: FUNSD Common Form Gold 50
notes: Use for golden-dataset evaluation, not product learning unless explicitly imported with source provenance.
All fields are optional because FUNSD documents are heterogeneous; evaluate only fields present in the labels for each document.
Expected values may include multiple entries per field/document; evaluation should compare raw output against the expected_values array or per-occurrence rows.
